rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible Gardner-style assessment (expanded blastocyst, ICM/TE both B) with reasonable descriptive detail, but the certainty of assigning 4BB and specific ICM location/TE quality from a single image is somewhat overconfident and may include features not clearly verifiable.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve markers, diagnosis discrepancy, prior IVF outcome, sperm parameters, BMI, and missing endometrial data with embryo prognosis and transfer planning.

Reasoning is generally logical and well structured, with a sensible probability estimate tied to age and morphology; minor issue is speculative handling of the AMH/DOR discrepancy and assumptions about blastocyst yield.

Mostly consistent with Gardner grading principles and standard IVF practice (proceeding with transfer, luteal support, uterine evaluation after failure). Slight deviations include somewhat liberal endorsement of PGT-A in a very young patient and speculative protocol suggestions.

Gives clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including endometrial assessment, luteal support, and post-failure workup; recommendations are useful though not highly individualized in protocol detail.
